claims: Denver, Colorado is the capital of Colorado.
Denver sits exactly 5,280 feet (1,609 meters) above sea level.
Denver is known as the "Mile High City".
Denver's official elevation is 1 mile or 5,280 feet above sea level.
Denver is located in the South Platte River Valley.
Denver is nestled against the Front Range of the Rocky Mountains.
Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre is known as the only naturally occurring, acoustically perfect amphitheater in the world.
The Denver Art Museum is located in the Golden Triangle Creative District.
Denver's neighborhoods include Capitol Hill, Five Points, and RiNo (River North).
Denver is the largest city in Colorado.
Denver was founded during the Pikes Peak Gold Rush.
Denver was initially a mining supply settlement.
Denver is home to the NFL's Denver Broncos.
Denver is home to the NBA's Denver Nuggets.
Denver is home to the MLB's Colorado Rockies.
Denver is home to the NHL's Colorado Avalanche.
